title: Getting ahead of the occasion
literal_meaning: Undressed before even seeing the river.
explanation: The image mocks preparation that runs ahead of any confirmed need. Someone has acted as though the next step were certain before checking whether the situation calls for it. The saying is sharper than a general reminder to plan carefully.
meaning_odia: ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ହେବା ଆଗରୁ ଅତି ତତ୍ପର ହେବା।
usage_example: Before a trip is agreed, a participant announces the departure date and begins making arrangements for everyone. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The river and undressing belong to the saying’s literal scene. They do not establish a particular place, journey or bathing custom as its origin.
